title: Filtered colimits of strictly henselian local rings along local maps
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty small directed poset and $(R_i,\varphi_{ij})_{i\leq j}$ a direct system of commutative local rings, with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_i$. Assume every $R_i$ is strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] and every transition homomorphism is local, meaning $\varphi_{ij}^{-1}(\mathfrak m_j)=\mathfrak m_i$. Let $R=\varinjlim_iR_i$ be the colimit in commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then $R$ is a strictly henselian local ring. Neither injectivity nor surjectivity of the transition maps is assumed.
